items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: another fella never gave me no recognition was John Hammond, I don't know why. Never recognized me

ctx.x: Yeah... Well I was invited down there to represent Tatum... So I accepted for him so he could get his name in the sidewalk. Now, another fella never gave me no recognition was John Hammond, I don't know why. Never recognized me -- miscellaneous I guess...
Did you ever have any dealings with him?
